high_level_description: The image depicts a formal event taking place in the State Dining Room of the White House. In the foreground, President Joe Biden is standing at a podium adorned with the presidential seal. He is dressed in a dark suit with a striped tie and is holding hands with Elizabeth Whelan, who is wearing a black outfit.
